name: eu-clause
relation: blocking the integration rests on the contract clause that keeps customer data in the EU
instruction: You decide whether an integration may be turned on for a customer. Use only the evidence given. Answer enable if it may be turned on as requested, block if it must not be, unclear if the evidence does not decide.

spans.text: Enterprise agreement §9.2: customer data is stored and processed only in the EU.
Enterprise agreement §4.1: invoices are payable within 30 days.
Enterprise agreement §11: either party may end the agreement with 90 days' notice.
Enterprise agreement §7.3: priority-1 tickets are answered within one hour.
Acme GmbH signed the Enterprise agreement in March.
ReplayCo, the session-replay vendor, records users' screens and stores the recordings in its US data centre.
Acme's product manager asked for session replay on their dashboard.

inputs.text: Can we turn on ReplayCo session replay for Acme GmbH?
